items.quote: Honestly we were skeptical at first because our last vendor kept promising and never delivering. But SSS actually shows up. Night guards are in position before 10pm, supervisor visits twice a week minimum, and the housekeeping team doesn't vanish during festival season like our earlier agency did. We run a 60-room resort in Dooars with year-round occupancy — can't afford gaps.
items.name: Manik Pradhan

items.quote: Switched from two separate agencies — one for security, one for housekeeping. The single-vendor model saved us roughly ₹1.8L per year and more importantly we finally have one point of contact. Earlier if something went wrong with cleaning, housekeeping blamed security and vice versa. Now there's one supervisor responsible for everything. The transition was bumpy first month, but they worked through it.
items.name: Priya Sengupta

items.quote: Hospital security is very different from a corporate building — stressed families, long OPD queues, patients in pain, sometimes aggressive attendants. The SSS team was trained specifically for healthcare settings. De-escalation, crowd management during visiting hours, night rounds in sensitive wards. We have completed 18 months now without a single serious incident. The team lead actually understands hospital protocols.
items.name: Dr. Aloke Roy
